plan.notes: The steel ball rolls off the ramp at about 1 m/s and knocks over the five dominoes from left to right. The last domino falls onto the back of the light toy car, which rolls a few centimetres into the bottom of the cup.
assumptions: The scale is set by the standard 5 cm dominoes. The ball is the library's 2.5 cm steel bearing, which matches the photo's estimate.
The toy car is shrunk to 10 cm, the smallest the library allows; the photo shows a car of about 6 cm, much smaller than the default 20 cm. It is made light (60 g) so a falling domino can push it.
The scene is laid out around the middle of the table. The cup stands well away from the table's real end, because the safety walls stop anything from falling off there anyway.
differences: Wedge ramp: the library's wedge only slopes down to the left, so a short plank on legs leaned at the same height and length makes the ramp. It has no groove.
Ramp colour: the plank is varnished light wood, not weathered grey wood.
Red toy car: the library's toy car is plastic with rubber wheels, 10 cm long instead of about 6 cm, and not a Fiat-500 shape.
Paper cup: it is fixed in place, so the car bumps into it instead of pushing it away. The bump is the checked outcome.
Domino spacing is set to 2.2 cm as in the photo, closer than the row's default.
